prediction_evaluation.conclusion: The V1 artillery kill hypothesis failed. Event observation alone does not prove why HP output was lower or why successor coverage did not hold.

first_failure_chain: Hibiscus died frame2280; its scheduled frame2820 skill therefore failed.
Ansel died frame3180 and Durin died frame3330, ending the second damage/medicine interval.
Lava died frame3780; nine later skills/actions failed for operators not deployed.
First leak armor #21 frame5046; second armor #22 frame5196; objective ended at frame5457 before the artillery leak.

comparison_to_m30.kept: V2's complete four-roadblock and two-arrival route structure remained possible.
comparison_to_m30.regressed: Artillery damage fell from 7348.45 to 6071.27 and legal-battle leaks rose from 10 to 14.
comparison_to_m30.hypothesis_rejected: Relocating eastern damage into overlapping medical coverage did not by itself sustain artillery output or central survival.

requirements_for_revision: State who continues artillery damage after each actual or scheduled removal and verify the target-selection condition, not just deployment duration.
Define how central medicine and interception survive the 2280, 3180, 3330 and 3780 death interval.
Do not treat all four roadblock clearances or two protected arrivals as equivalent to zero leaks.
The first observable prediction must concern artillery death, sustained artillery damage, prevention of the armor leak, or removal/redeployment handoff; an opening kill is insufficient.
